command:
cat > /root/ansible/inventory-backup/backup.yml <<'YAML_EOF'
---
- name: Archive inventory data on source node
  hosts: node2
  gather_facts: no
  vars:
    inventory_src: /srv/inventory/data
    tmp_archive: /tmp/inventory-backup.tar.gz
  tasks:
    - name: Compute backup date stamp
      raw: "date +%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S"
      register: datestamp_raw
      changed_when: false

    - name: Save date stamp as fact
      set_fact:
        datestamp: "{{ datestamp_raw.stdout | trim }}"

    - name: Archive inventory data directory
      raw: "tar -czf {{ tmp_archive }} -C {{ inventory_src }} ."
      changed_when: true

    - name: Read archive content as base64
      raw: "base64 -w0 {{ tmp_archive }}"
      register: archive_b64
      changed_when: false

    - name: Save archive content as fact
      set_fact:
        archive_content: "{{ archive_b64.stdout | trim }}"

    - name: Remove temporary archive from source node
      raw: "rm -f {{ tmp_archive }}"
      changed_when: true

- name: Store dated backup on destination node and enforce retention
  hosts: node1
  gather_facts: no
  vars:
    backup_dir: /var/backups/inventory
    datestamp: "{{ hostvars['node2'].datestamp }}"
    archive_content: "{{ hostvars['node2'].archive_content }}"
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure backup directory exists
      raw: "mkdir -p {{ backup_dir }}"
      changed_when: true

    - name: Write dated backup archive
      raw: "printf '%s' '{{ archive_content }}' | base64 -d > {{ backup_dir }}/inventory-data-{{ datestamp }}.tar.gz"
      changed_when: true

    - name: Retain only the last 7 daily backups
      raw: "cd {{ backup_dir }} && ls -1t inventory-data-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | tail -n +8 | xargs -r rm -f"
      changed_when: true

    - name: List current backups on destination
      raw: "ls -la {{ backup_dir }}"
      register: backup_listing
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show backup listing
      debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_listing.stdout_lines }}"
YAML_EOF
echo written
